company_name: Micro System Integration Center, Tohoku University
semiconductor_relevance: High — the Micro System Integration Center focuses on R&D support for MEMS and microsystem technology, which are integral to semiconductor applications.
summary: The Micro System Integration Center at Tohoku University provides research and development support for micro system technology, particularly in MEMS and microsystem manufacturing. They collaborate with industry and academia to advance materials, devices, and processing technologies, utilizing a large clean room facility for microfabrication.
capabilities: Collaboration with industry for industrialization of microsystems

regional_presence.Japan: The center operates within Tohoku University, leveraging its facilities for collaboration with industry and research institutions.
